description: Canonical N-Quads: every node has an IRI, computed inverses are materialised, lines are sorted by their serialised bytes and each is terminated by a single LF. Because the dataset is blank-node-free, canonicalisation is this sort. The graph term: every line is a quad whose fourth term is the Bundle IRI `<https://example.org/>` (AGSC-04-15 as amended at rc.6, PY2-01), so each line of graph-0001 is restated here with ` <https://example.org/>` inserted before its terminating ` .`; nothing else moves, and because the same suffix is added to every line the byte order of the lines is unchanged.
note: added 2026-09-23 at rc.6 (EXT-2b, PY2-01); derived by hand from AGSC-04-15 as amended and AGSC-05-03, superseding graph-0001
